statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH (yellow). NQ is quoted at 28,939.50, down 1.52%, about 123 points above the 28,816.25 session low, which has now held for two full hours. The retracement is steady near 42% of the 28,816.25-29,111.00 session range rather than failing. VIX at 17.59 sits near its 17.46 session low after an 18.17 high, the 2Y at 4.639% is easing rather than extending, and index internals are split, with chipmakers sharply lower while large software names trade higher. Tail eases one point to 21 and remains in the watch band.
recommendation: Tail at 21 sits in the watch band, below the block threshold, so the mapped state is WATCH for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The danger window is unchanged at 13:00-16:00 UTC, covering the 13:30 UTC cash open and the first two cash hours, because that transition is the session's first genuine liquidity transfer of the AI-warning and oil shock. Conditional Tail re-enters the elevated band only across those three hours and peaks at 27, eight points below the strong-block threshold. From 16:00 UTC the conditional path returns to the watch band and reaches the EA_ON mapping across the thinnest overnight hours. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by this mapping.
headline: The 28,816.25 low holds a second hour and NQ steadies near a 42% retracement while VIX sits at its session low and the 2Y eases; Tail slips to 21 with the danger window held at the 13:00-16:00 UTC cash open
body:
The one-way structure that carried the 09:00 and 10:00 UTC assessments into the block band remains contradicted by the observed path. As of 12:17 UTC, NQ is quoted at 28,939.50, down 447.50 points or 1.52% against a 29,387.00 reference. The session low is still 28,816.25, set around 10:15 UTC, so it has now survived two full hours and the sequence of consecutive lower lows remains broken at four. The contract sits roughly 123 points above that low, about 42% of the 28,816.25 to 29,111.00 range, essentially unchanged from the 43% measured an hour ago. That is consolidation rather than either extension or a failed retracement, and Tail measures the probability of a path that denies mean reversion long enough to overwhelm a reverse or grid approach. A low that has held two hours while the bounce neither fails nor extends is evidence against that path, so Tail eases one point to 21.

The cross-asset picture has not re-aligned into an amplifier. The December contract quoted separately on another venue shows the same shape, trading about 47% off its own session low, which confirms the structure is not an artifact of one data feed. ES at 7,614.00 sits mid-range between 7,593.75 and 7,634.50 and is down only 0.59%, a materially smaller decline than the Nasdaq's, which points to a sector-specific repricing rather than a broad risk-off flush. VIX at 17.59 is up 11.05% on the day but is trading near its 17.46 session low after an 18.17 high, so implied volatility is decaying rather than building. The 2-year yield at 4.639% is down 0.5 basis points and is off its 4.643% session high, while the 10-year at 4.986% is up 1.1 basis points inside a narrow 4.957 to 4.988 range. Neither leg of the curve is extending against equities.

Index internals are the clearest de-amplifier. Reuters reports Intel down 5.5%, AMD down 5.1% and Marvell down 7% in premarket trade, with Nvidia off more than 2%, while ServiceNow, Adobe and Workday trade 4.3%, 2.4% and 2.6% higher. That is rotation within the index, not a uniform one-way liquidation, and dispersion of that kind normally raises Stress and lowers directional conviction rather than raising Tail. The two catalysts remain a weekend essay from Anthropic's chief executive arguing for a slower pace of AI model development, publicly agreed with by the heads of OpenAI and xAI, and a Middle East supply shock after Saudi Arabia shut its East-West pipeline following a drone strike, with Brent near $107 and WTI at $103.13. Oil is the one amplifier that is firming rather than fading, having recovered from $102.54 an hour ago toward its $103.81 session high, and it remains an unresolved second-wave mechanism.

Stress stays high at 76. The combination of an unresolved supply shock, a narrative repricing of the index's largest theme, and traders pricing close to a 9-in-10 chance of a rate increase at Wednesday's FOMC is a genuinely difficult environment, and high Stress can coexist with Tail below the block threshold. Confidence holds at 88: current levels for NQ, ES, VIX, both yield tenors and crude were all verified directly, the catalysts were confirmed against primary reporting, and the seven-day US calendar including the 16 September FOMC decision at 18:00 UTC was verified against a scheduled-release source. The shared Finviz cross-asset context was collected at 07:12 UTC with partial status and is outside the 90-minute freshness window, so it was not used; the assessment rests on independently verified current sources. The danger window is held at 13:00 to 16:00 UTC around the cash open, where the premarket structure will either be confirmed or rejected on real volume.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding published hours were available. Tail climbed steadily through Sunday's US hours from 14 at 12:00 UTC to 19 by 20:00 UTC, crossed into the watch band at 21 with the Globex reopen and peaked at 22 in the 22:00 UTC hour as the AI-slowdown story was first priced. Across the overnight session it was unusually stable, printing 20 in six of the eight Asian and early European hours with two 19s. The European morning then produced the sharpest sequence of the 24: 21 at 07:00 UTC, 23 at 08:00 UTC, then 26 and 25 in the two hours that carried the mapped state into the block band as NQ made four consecutive lower lows. The 11:00 UTC hour returned to the watch band at 22 once the 28,816.25 low held and the retracement reached 43%. Stress was the more persistent signal throughout, never falling below 66 and peaking at 79. Dominant mode moved from normal through a single event/whipsaw hour at the reopen, then mixed overnight, trend-down for the two block-band hours, and back to mixed.
outlookSummary: The danger window is unchanged at 13:00 to 16:00 UTC and still does not start at the current hour. The current hour sits in the watch band at 21 because the observed retracement has now held for two hours. Conditional Tail re-enters the elevated band at 26 for the opening-auction hour and peaks at 27 for the first full cash hour, which is where a genuine no-retracement path would most plausibly establish itself if the 28,816.25 low gives way on cash volume. It steps back to 25 for the third cash hour on expected volatility decay, then returns to the watch band from 16:00 UTC and to the EA_ON mapping from 21:00 UTC across the thinnest overnight hours, bottoming at 16 through the Asian session. The conditional path then rebuilds gradually through the European open to 20 and 21 as Tuesday's 12:15 UTC ADP weekly and 12:30 UTC Empire State prints come into view, with Wednesday's FOMC decision the week's dominant scheduled checkpoint. Confidence decays from 88 to 62 purely as a function of distance from the 12:17 UTC evidence cutoff.
